==Description==
'''Demon Swing''' is an [[Emotes|emote]] that could have been obtained through the [[Halloween 2020 Event#Halloween Season Pass|Halloween Season]]. It was made by [https://www.roblox.com/users/16983447/profile BelowNatural]. The emote is looped and music can be heard while performing the emote. You cannot move while performing this emote.

This emote was obtainable at Rank 7 of the Event Season Pass, which would cost 450 Candies or {{Robux|140}} at that rank. The total cost to get from Rank 1 to Rank 7 was 1,835 Candies or {{Robux|590}}.

==Trivia==
*This [[Emotes|emote]] is based on the dance that multiple sprites perform in [[wp:Helltaker|Helltaker]].
**The shirt and pants shown in the icon is based on [[w:c:helltaker:Cerberus|Cerberus']] attire in ''Helltaker''.
***This and [[The Z Step]] are the only two emotes to not use the green-blue Robloxian or a white character on its icon.
**The music played from this emote is a remixed version of [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EnDXGQmCz3U Mittsies - Vitality], which is the background music that plays in acts I-IX and their cutscenes in ''Helltaker''.
*The inventory description is a reference to [https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/i-can-be-your-angle-or-yuor-devil I Can Be Your Angle Or Yuor Devil] meme.
